svg.title: Hand-trace of the GROUP BY / HAVING query
svg.desc: The query, then three tables side by side: FROM+JOIN gives 9 rows, GROUP BY makes 6 user-genre groups, and HAVING COUNT >= 2 keeps 3, not the 4 the query claimed.
svg.text: Hand-trace the query: rows in, survivors out
The query claims 4 user-genre pairs. Walk each clause and see what really survives.
-- Find user-genre pairs where the user listened to >= 2 songs in that genre.

g.text: 9 rows, every listen with its genre
Answer: 3 pairs survive, not the 4 claimed.
